# ICM — Instrument Cluster Module on Trampoline RTOS
# Osvaldo Janeri Filho <janeri@gmail.com>
#
# Host unit tests for the RTOS-independent modules. The application itself is
# not built here: it is generated by GOIL from src/icm.oil and compiled by the
# Python build system GOIL writes (tools/build.sh). CMake only covers what can
# run without an operating system underneath, which is also what makes these
# tests fast enough to run on every save.
#
#   cmake -S . -B build/unit && cmake --build build/unit && ctest --test-dir build/unit

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.14)
project(icm_unit_tests LANGUAGES C)

set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_C_EXTENSIONS OFF)

# Same pure modules the RTOS build compiles, no copies.
add_library(icm_pure STATIC
  src/can_db.c
  src/signal_proc.c
  src/diag.c
  src/dashboard.c
)
target_include_directories(icm_pure PUBLIC src)
target_compile_options(icm_pure PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Wconversion)

enable_testing()

foreach(suite test_can_db test_signal_proc test_diag test_dashboard)
  add_executable(${suite} tests/unit/${suite}.c)
  target_link_libraries(${suite} PRIVATE icm_pure m)
  target_compile_options(${suite} PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra)
  add_test(NAME ${suite} COMMAND ${suite})
endforeach()
